constraints.description: DO NOT exceed the spacings shown from the centre of one cut to the centre of the next cut. Inject each stem of a multi-stem tree where possible. Injection at or near ground level is essential in the Traprock area of south-eastern Queensland and is preferred for optimum results in poplar box areas. In areas where experience has shown that results are variable because species are harder to kill or due to marginal soil and/or climate factors, higher doses may improve control. Contact TITAN AG Pty Ltd for more detail.
